description: Reusable, read-only query templates used by harness-onboarding and the workflow skills. Placeholders in {curly_braces} are filled from the profile or the current user. All entries here are GETs/searches only — no template mutates remote state.

jira.my_recent_issues_jql: assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC
jira.derive_project_keys: From my_recent_issues, tally issue key prefixes; the top 1-3 prefixes are the candidate project_keys.
jira.stale_in_progress_jql: project IN ({project_keys}) AND status = 'In Progress' AND updated <= -5d ORDER BY updated ASC
jira.missing_estimate_jql: project IN ({project_keys}) AND sprint IN openSprints() AND 'Story Points' IS EMPTY
jira.unassigned_jql: project IN ({project_keys}) AND statusCategory != Done AND assignee IS EMPTY ORDER BY created DESC
jira.open_support_jql: project IN ({project_keys}) AND labels = support AND statusCategory != Done AND assignee IS EMPTY ORDER BY created DESC

confluence.find_person_team_cql: type = page AND text ~ "{name}" AND (title ~ "team" OR title ~ "squad" OR title ~ "org chart")
confluence.ground_answer_cql: type = page AND text ~ "{query}" AND space.key IN ({confluence_space_keys})

slack.find_channels: use mcp__claude_ai_Slack__slack_search_channels with query patterns: {team}, support, incidents, alerts, pr, releases
slack.scan_support_channel: use mcp__claude_ai_Slack__slack_read_channel on each support channel; a thread is 'unanswered' per triage-rubric.md

compass.alias_source: Read team_definitions.json from the installed sosafe-engineering-metrics plugin (skills/compass-metrics/definitions/team_definitions.json) and fuzzy-match team.name to an alias.
compass.delegate: For any metrics/scorecard request, hand off by intent to compass-analyst, e.g. 'Get scorecards for {compass_alias}, last {sprint_length_days} days'. Do not re-implement Compass.

monitoring.description: All read-only and optional. Probe each; skip silently if the tool/credentials are absent.
monitoring.datadog: If mcp__claude_ai_Datadog__* tools (or a datadog-ci/API path) are available, list monitors scoped by integrations.datadog.monitor_tags and read named dashboards. Otherwise skip.
monitoring.amplitude: If an Amplitude connector or integrations.amplitude.project_ids + credentials exist, surface named charts/dashboards (links only). Otherwise skip.
